ja475:1.1: Kuṭhārihattho puriso vanam ogayha tiṭṭhasi, puṭṭho me samma akkhāhi, kiṃ dāruṃ chetum icchasīti.
ja475:2.1: Iso vanāni carasi samāni visamāni ca, puṭṭho me samma akkhāhi, kiṃ dāruṃ nemiyā daḷhan ti.
ja475:3.1: N' eva sālo na khadiro n' assakaṇṇo kuto dhavo, rukkho va phandano nāma, taṃ dāruṃ nemiyā daḷhan ti.
ja475:4.1: Kīdisāni 'ssa pattāni, khandho vā pana kīdiso, puṭṭho me samma akkhāhi, yathā jānemu phandanan ti.
ja475:5.1: Yassa sākhā palambanti namanti na ca bhañjare so rukkho phandano nāma yassa mūle ahaṃ ṭhito.
ja475:6.1: Arānaṃ cakkanābhīnaṃ īsanemirathassa ca sabbassa te kammaniyo ayaṃ hessati phandano
ja475:7.1: ti. Iti phandanarukkho pi tāvade ajjhabhāsatha: mayham pi vacanaṃ atthi, Bhāradvāja suṇohi me.
ja475:8.1: Issassa upakhandhamhā okkacca caturaṅgulaṃ tena nemiṃ pariharesi, evaṃ daḷhataraṃ siyā.
ja475:9.1: Iti phandanarukkho pi veraṃ appesi tāvade jātānañ ca ajātānaṃ īsānaṃ dukkham āvahīti.
ja475:10.1: Icc-eva phandano īsaṃ īso ca pana phandanaṃ aññamaññaṃ vivādena aññamaññaṃ aghātayuṃ.
ja475:11.1: Evam eva manussesu vivādo yattha jāyati mayūranaccaṃ naccanti yathā ne īsaphandanā.
ja475:12.1: Taṃ vo vadāmi, bhaddaṃ vo, yāvant' ettha samāgatā: sammodatha mā vivadittha, mā hotha īsaphandanā.
ja475:13.1: Sāmaggim eva sikkhetha, buddheh' etaṃ pasaṃsitaṃ, sāmaggirato dhammaṭṭho yogakkhemā na dhaṃsatīti
